stated_limits: 1 <= nums[i] <= 1e9, 1 <= k <= 1e9; the length of nums is NOT stated
reason: the prompt states no bound on len(nums), so there is no complexity to enforce (an O(n^3) brute passes the current check)
notes: valid() adds len(nums) >= 1: with an empty array there is no non-empty subarray and the answer is undefined. This check's weakness is correctness (3 surviving mutants), not input size.
